translation: For the doubtful and difficult cases, he would often spend a full hour, only fearing a slight error, and only after there was no doubt would he move his mind. His conduct was again like this. If this man, having once passed the examination and become a governing official, extended this Way and used this mind to go and plan for his state and to fulfill well the trust of the people of ten thousand li, how could one match him? There is the book 《Waitai Miyao》 (Arcane Essentials from the Imperial Library) by Prefect Wang of the Tang dynasty. It passed through the Five Dynasties, and in the Song dynasty Censor-in-Chief Sun once corrected and published it, and it has been cut off down to the present. Master Cheng could not bear to let it fail to circulate among people, and so he spoke to me of it.
